observations: A modern office desk with a grey slatted front panel.
The desk has a light grey or off-white side pedestal/cabinet on the right side.
The desktop has a grey wood-grain finish with a thick, rounded, light-colored edge trim.
The item is located in a showroom with tiled floors and other office furniture visible in the background.
There is a blue sign with a QR code and Chinese text, along with some brochures, resting on the desk.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BIONIC INTERIORS' is overlaid on the center of the image.

proof_requests: Photo of the desk with a measuring tape showing the 1.6m length.
Photo of the user-facing side (the back of the desk where the chair goes).
Photo of the pedestal drawers open showing the interior condition and keys.
response.reason: The item is a standard office desk clearly visible in a showroom setting. While the specific dimensions and internal condition are unverified, it can be priced as a generic unit of this type at its worst-case size and condition.
